{{Top|leg}}
The '''triz''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]]. It was known to compulsively bury its dead.

Many [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|females]] were named after the species.
